snippet.title: Gundam Conquest V Trailer 2015 PS VITA
snippet.description:
Bandai Namco Entertainment has released a new trailer for the upcoming free-to-play PS Vita title Gundam Conquest V which features the game’s various gameplay mechanics, such as the strategic section that allows players to produce resources and build armies, an action section that gives players the liberty to control their mobile suits, and more. Additionally, the game will feature a multiplayer mode that allows players to bring their own mobile suits and pilots.

Gundam Conquest V is an enhanced version of last year’s Gundam Conquest which released for smartphones and reached over 3.5 million downloads. The free-to-play title will be releasing for PS Vita this summer in Japan.
